title: MiRL: Error-Targeted Reinforcement Learning for Correcting Terminal Agent Misbehaviors
abstract: arXiv:2610.35697v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. translated_title: MiRL：面向错误靶向的强化学习，用于纠正终端智能体的错误行为
translated_abstract: 靶向错误的学习为改进模型提供了一种清晰明了的方式：识别模型的特定弱点，训练模型以修复这些弱点，并检验这些弱点是否已被修复。我们研究如何将靶向错误的学习应用于终端智能体——这类智能体通过与命令行终端交互来完成以自然语言指定的长时程任务。现有的靶向错误方法是针对单轮任务设计的，而现有的智能体失败分析主要用于评估和调试智能体，而非用于训练智能体。我们提出错误行为驱动的强化学习，它首先对策略的错误进行分析，以找出可泛化的错误行为，即在众多环境中反复出现的错误步骤类型。随后，MiRL使用强化学习训练该策略，从这些错误行为发生的步骤开始启动推演，并且仅当推演通过测试且避免了错误行为时才给予奖励。在Qwen3.5-4B上，八种错误行为占错误步骤的52.1%……
tldr: 本文提出MiRL方法，通过分析终端智能体的错误以发现跨环境反复出现的可泛化错误行为，并从错误发生步骤启动强化学习训练、仅在通过测试且避免错误行为时给予奖励，从而有针对性地纠正智能体的错误行为。
en_tdlr: MiRL profiles terminal agents' recurring, generalizable misbehaviors and applies reinforcement learning from the steps where these misbehaviors occur, rewarding rollouts only if they pass tests and avoid the misbehaviors, thereby correcting agent failures in an error-targeted manner.
